prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: premium 3D scientific illustration for the right-hand side of the CYMBA earbuds landing-page science section.
Create one beautifully refined contemporary white sculpture of a human head and short neck, seen in a near-profile three-quarter view facing LEFT, with the near-side outer ear clearly visible. It is an elegant androgynous sculptural object, not a photograph of a real person. Entire crown, nose, ear, chin and short neck fit inside the composition with comfortable margins. A single bust only, no pedestal, no earbuds or other objects.
Materials: satin-matte white porcelain or fine white mineral resin, smooth continuous surfaces, subtle realistic soft shadows and ambient occlusion. Face remains opaque white. A carefully integrated frosted translucent anatomical window over the side/back of the cranium and around the ear reveals delicate internal structures. Keep the head recognisable as a solid white sculpture; avoid a fully glass head.
Main feature: a thin restrained warm champagne-gold auricular vagus sensory pathway visible through the translucent material. Show a tiny fine branching network at the conchal bowl of the outer ear, a fine inward/deep connection toward the lower brainstem, and a small elegant warm highlighted relay region in the lower brainstem. The vagal sensory connection should travel from the ear medially toward the brainstem, not wind around the face, cross the cerebral cortex, or take a decorative loop down the neck. This is a simplified conceptual anatomical illustration, not a tractography scan. Pale white internal brain and brainstem forms are only faintly visible to supply context. The coloured nerve pathway should be visually distinct, delicate and organic, not thick wires. A restrained muted amber highlight gives legibility; minimal bloom, no neon. Do not imply that current is injected directly into the brain. No arbitrary highlighted cortical region, no whole-brain activation, no other coloured nerves.
Art direction: high-end contemporary product design meets museum-quality anatomical sculpture. Quiet, clinical precision with soft tactile material. Broad diffused studio key light from upper left and subtle rim lighting. White form with dimensional grey shading, very light cool neutral palette, champagne (#9c7b4a) pathway. Designed to look beautiful against the site's cool off-white (#f5f5f7) page.
Composition: a generous square canvas, head centred and filling approximately 82% of height; room around the silhouette for future vector annotations. No text, numbers, labels, arrows, callouts, logo, watermark, border, UI, floor, environment or backdrop. Genuinely transparent alpha background; retain the white sculpture and coloured internal structures with crisp antialiased edges. Render at high resolution and polished photorealistic 3D quality.
